ValidationRule.description: [Sheet row 50 / OppVR70] Close Date cannot be in the past on moving into Qualification/Solutioning, or when moving to Solutioning/Negotiation. Approved by IRM (matches IRM's restated intent), no change.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( CloseDate < TODAY(),
OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Qualification'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Solutioning'), AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), OR(ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Solutioning'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Negotiation')) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Invalid Close Date. The Close Date cannot be in the past. Please select today's date or a future date.
